question.text: The metal which can be used to obtain metallic Cu from aqueous CuSO $_{4}$ solution is

solution.text:
Iron (Fe) is used to obtain Curmetal from CuSO, (aq) because Fe is more reactive than Cu (and also easly available and is cheaper) thus, replace the copper from CuSO $_{4}$ to give copper (Cu)
$\mathrm{CuSO}_{4}(\mathrm{aq})+\mathrm{Fe}(\mathrm{s}) \longrightarrow \mathrm{FeSO}_{4}(\mathrm{aq})+\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{s})$
